verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents snapshot/restore that can checkpoint a workspace and roll an existing sandbox back to a known filesystem state. That gives point-in-time versions and rollback for whatever automation code lives in a sandbox. However, nothing describes versioning, diffing, or review of automations themselves (templates, functions, webhooks). Template updates via GitHub Actions rely on the user's own CI rather than a product feature. Missing for 10: explicit version history for automations/templates, review or diff workflow before changes, rollback scoped to automation definitions rather than whole-sandbox filesystem snapshots, independent corroboration.
